bridge.narrative: OWASP's June 28 reframing makes prompt injection an unpatchable design constraint mapping to six of ten agentic categories, and names coding agents the epicenter with Claude Code, n8n and AutoGPT topping the advisory tally. That forces the conclusion the prediction rests on: defenses must be orchestration-layer capability budgets, exactly the Rule-of-Two gate the thesis expects a platform to ship default-on.
bridge.remaining_gap: No coding-agent platform has shipped a default-on trifecta capability gate; the report supplies the rationale and epicenter naming but not a shipped enforcement default.
